fields.assessment_notes: JJ's Collectibles is one of the strongest close Magic candidates, not merely a Tuesday Commander lead. Previously inspected Discord evidence includes a dedicated Magic category, Magic announcements, Commander guidance, and promotional images for Precon Commander Night, Jumpstart, a Marvel Commander Party, and Hobbit prerelease events. Those July/August announcements are historical activity evidence, not upcoming-event promises. The same retained evidence supports a rhythm across Commander, draft, Standard, and Pauper. Commander-channel notes support random pod formation and bracket/power-level guidance, improving the solo-arrival read. Review-derived evidence adds friendly staff, fair pricing, trade-night/community, stock, prerelease product, and welcoming-service signals. Remaining questions are practical: which recurring Commander lane is best for a first visit, actual turnout, and proxy norms. Use the Events tab for currently dated listings.
